status: read consumers integrated into Windows library branches; complete Windows product driver and output publication remain disabled

platform.normal_paths: exact Unicode absolute drive paths; no UNC/device/verbatim, relative resolution, prefix stripping or reparse fallback

casc.admission: public admit reads complete .build.info under ReadFile with LinkPolicy::Allow before the unchanged product/build metadata parser
casc.routing: Windows cfg selects guarded whole-file, index enumeration and archive-span reads; non-Windows paths retain their existing implementation
casc.links: LinkPolicy::Allow fixes complete file identity and link count; no reparse points admitted

guard.capture: fresh full file or directory lease, capture exact path/type/full identity and immediately drop OS handles
guard.retained: exact path, kind, captured identity and optional authored expected bytes; no persistent file handles or hidden descriptor cache
guard.check: reacquire matching typed lease and compare every captured identity field; verify held/named snapshot before success
guard.expected_bytes: optional exact comparison in 4096-byte chunks under one retained file lease
guard.directory: full final-directory snapshot; sibling mutation is not silently reduced to same-object equality
guard.failure: unavailable or mismatching previously captured input maps to local_store_input_changed; no silent refresh
guard.poison: Guard and LocalStore do not themselves promise permanent poison across reacquisition; acquisition::Session permanently poisons future reads after an observed InputChanged

casc.enumeration: one directory lease spans read_dir; iterator is dropped before full verification; directory lease drops before independent index-file leases
casc.whole: enforce existing caller total limit, phase budget and exact allocation before guarded range acquisition
casc.archive: plan against captured archive size; reserve encoded/decode scratch before allocation; guarded complete range and post-decode identity verification
casc.range: single complete retained file lease; verify before/after full acquisition; positional reads chunk at most 64 MiB with checked offset arithmetic
casc.content: existing complete decoded size and CKey MD5 authentication retained; no zero-filled incomplete payload or network fallback

limits.allowance_scope: conservative logical path/prefix/handle/enumeration reservation charged once during store open; not measured heap, RSS or kernel resource bound

input.bytes: complete explicit input at caller limit using captured size, one retained lease, checked 64-MiB chunks and final verification; total may exceed one primitive chunk
input.keys: only explicitly named complete key file, bounded at existing 256 KiB and parsed by the existing opaque keyring API; source lease stays retained in SuppliedKeys
input.links: LinkPolicy::Reject for both explicit input APIs
input.key_lease_lifetime: until SuppliedKeys is consumed through into_keyring or dropped; no source pathname serialized
input.output_protection: retained readonly source lease is not alias-safe output-path containment or a Windows publication protocol

outputs.component_operations: DB2 batch create/publish, GT create/create_catalog/publish/complete, camera create/publish/complete reject before output I/O on Windows
outputs.filesystem_mutation: none from unsupported Windows component-output entrypoints

validation.contract_tests: static source/contract consistency only; no actual Win32 execution
validation.windows_synthetic_ci: whole workspace and all targets, no native feature or ignored external corpus
validation.wine: per-run preliminary evidence belongs to external coordinator reports; does not prove real NTFS, privilege, junction or cloud-reparse semantics

not_claimed: Windows output DACL or crash durability
